title: useForm
subtitle: Create + subscribe to a form
description: React hook that creates a form for the component lifetime and returns snapshot + actions.

signature.code: function useForm<T>(config: FormConfig<T>): FormSnapshot<T> & Actions & { form: Form<T> }

content: Recreates when `config.key` changes. Syncs `config.data` via `form.setData` when it changes by `Object.is`. Does **not** wrap a provider — use `FormProvider`.

returns.description: Same snapshot fields as Form, plus bound actions and the raw instance.

examples.title: Sync external data
